_note: Exemplar POST /watches/feasibility responses. The prototype decided these with a regex router; the backend should replace that with real rules. Note the refusals: the product deliberately declines to count cars or identify people.

request.text: count the cars in the parking lot

response.title: Not possible with satellites
notes: Free satellites see 10 m pixels — a car or a person is smaller than one pixel.
Even 30 cm paid imagery cannot identify individuals, and we would not offer it.
response.alternative: Watch for new buildings, roads or cleared land at this place instead

request.text: how many people are in the field

response.title: Not possible with satellites
notes: Free satellites see 10 m pixels — a car or a person is smaller than one pixel.
Even 30 cm paid imagery cannot identify individuals, and we would not offer it.
response.alternative: Watch for new buildings, roads or cleared land at this place instead

request.text: is there a fire near my farm

response.title: Fire near my places
notes: Small fires under ~1,000 m² may not be detected.
Alerts arrive 3–5 hours after the pass.

response.title: Flooding on my place
notes: Radar passes every 6 days, so a short flood can be missed.
Wet soil after heavy rain can look like shallow water.

request.text: has forest been cleared on this plot

response.title: New forest clearing
notes: Selective logging of single trees is below 10 m and usually not seen.

request.text: is there an algae bloom near the intake

response.title: Algae bloom near intake
notes: 300 m pixels — fine near open water, unreliable within ~600 m of the shore.

response.title: Crop stress on a small plot
response.condition: Stress on more than 10% of plot
notes: Your plot is small for free 10 m data. We can watch it with free Sentinel-2 at low confidence, or with paid 3 m imagery.

request.text: where are the dry patches in my field

response.title: Dry patches on my field
notes: Cloudy passes are skipped; in a wet week you may wait 10+ days for an update.
Areas under ~0.3 ha are below what 10 m pixels can size reliably.
